fullPassage: While stories clearly dominate statistics from both memorability and persuasiveness perspectives, it's rarely a battle between facts and anecdotes — or even facts and other facts. The real clash is actually between stories: the predominant incumbent and a new challenger. As storytelling creatures, we routinely form narratives to help us understand the world around us. When we experience different events or encounter various facts, our minds seek to make sense of them by forming stories around them. For example, if you have had some bad experiences with graduates from a particular university, you may create a negative narrative in your mind about people who went to that school. Suddenly, you judge everyone from the university by what you've experienced on just a few unfortunate occasions. Sometimes these internal narratives we form not only shape our beliefs and opinions but also become deeply rooted in our identity. For example, the narratives you have formed around gun control or climate change are most likely related with your political ideology — who you are as an individual.

When we experience different events or encounter various facts, our minds seek to make sense of them by forming stories around them. For example, if you have had some bad experiences with graduates from a particular university, you may create a negative narrative in your mind about people who went to that school. Suddenly, you judge everyone from the university by what you've experienced on just a few unfortunate occasions. Sometimes these internal narratives we form not only shape our beliefs and opinions but also become deeply rooted in our identity. For example, the narratives you have formed around gun control or climate change are most likely related with your political ideology — who you are as an individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: the predominant incumbent and a new challenger의 함축 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① 정치인 사이의 선거 경쟁 관계 (a political election competition between candidates): 문자적 해석. 본문은 이야기 간 비유

❌ ② 사실과 허구 사이의 끝없는 대결 (an endless battle between facts and fiction): 본문에서 이미 사실 간 대결을 부정

❌ ③ 전통적 가치와 새로운 혁신의 긴장 (the tension between traditional values and innovation): 너무 광범위한 해석

✅ ④ 기존의 지배적 이야기와 그에 도전하는 새로운 이야기 (the existing dominant narrative versus a competing new narrative): incumbent=기존 지배 이야기, challenger=새 도전 이야기 ← 정답
det.tip: incumbent(현직자/기존 세력) + challenger(도전자) = 이야기 간 경쟁의 비유적 표현

ch: 기존의 지배적 이야기와 그에 도전하는 새로운 이야기

❌ ③ S3 뒤: 내러티브 형성의 예시로 넘어가는 부분이므로 부적절

❌ ④ S7 뒤: 정체성과 이념 이야기 후이므로 흐름 단절
